changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF TYPE_ID(N'dbo.ObjectFields') IS NOT NULL BEGIN DROP TYPE [dbo].[ObjectFields] END
changeSet.rollback: IF TYPE_ID(N'dbo.ObjectFields') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TYPE [dbo].[ObjectFields] AS TABLE( [FieldTypeID] [int] NULL, [FieldTypeName] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [FieldValue] [nvarchar](max) NULL, PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [FieldTypeName] ASC ) WITH (IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF) ) END
